description: This file provides utility functions for handling Go type names and their conversion to REST-friendly OpenAPI names, including deprecated and current methods, as well as interfaces for naming conventions and a function to derive canonical type names, handling vendored paths.

methods.name: ToCanonicalName
methods.description: Converts a Go package/type canonical name into a REST-friendly OpenAPI name, delegating to ToRESTFriendlyName.

methods.name: ToRESTFriendlyName
methods.description: Converts a Go package/type canonical name into a REST-friendly OpenAPI name by reversing the domain parts.

methods.name: GetCanonicalTypeName
methods.description: Determines the canonical type name of a given Go object, handling vendored paths and supporting custom naming interfaces.
